subject: ddl: support pre-split index regions before creating index (#57553)
summary: Reviewed executor split-key interpolation refactor (`pkg/executor/split.go` now calls `pkg/util.GetValuesList`) and parser support for `PRE_SPLIT_REGIONS` as an index option (`pkg/parser/parser.y`, `pkg/parser/ast/ddl.go`, `pkg/parser/ast/dml.go`). The change is largely additive/refactor: grammar wires `PRE_SPLIT_REGIONS` into `IndexOptionList`, `IndexOption.Restore/Accept` traverses/restores the new `SplitOpt`, and `SplitOption` is made visitable via its own `Accept`. No plausible Blocker/High correctness, SQL-semantic, compatibility, or runtime issues were found in the executor/parser surface touched by this commit.
